notes.title: Arcanima: Mist of Oblivion - Prologue anniversary
notes.content:
Hello, anima users!

Today, it's been one year since the launch of Arcanima: Mist of Oblivion - Prologue, and we wanted to ley you know!

Let you know how thankful we are to each and everyone of you for your support. Developing this game and releasing it meant going through a lot of challenges, which were worth to surpass in order to bring you a hopefully enjoyable experience.

It was like a dream come true to release our first game, and we will be ever so grateful for you allowing us to fulfill that dream.

As a celebration and to help the game get to new audiences, we are making our pricing more accesible in different parts of the world, specially latin-america. We hope for your continued support as the community grows :)

With love,

Stendhal Games

notes.title: Arcanima: Mist of Oblivion - Prologue is now available for purchase!
notes.content:
After three years of development, we're happy to deliver [b]the first chapter of Arcanima: Mist of Oblivion[/b] to you!

[previewyoutube=Me1qyQM7eRQ?;full][/previewyoutube]

In the prologue of this [b]Hack N Slash x JRPG[/b] you will join [b]Juno[/b] in assaulting the flying secluded [b]Citadel of Indomita[/b] to fulfill her duty as one of the select [b]'Syzyzy'[/b] members. Many secrets and strings are being pulled in the background as she takes the first step on the journey of her lifetime.

[b]'Focus'[/b] to weave the pace of combat, [b]slash your enemies[/b] with stylish combos and [b]make your way[/b] through Indomita to [b]help Juno find answers[/b]! Will your-self be the one able to [b]clear the Mist of Oblivion[/b]?

But be prepared: [b]Battles of Wills[/b] are awaiting you. These are [b]boss battles that you have only one chance to beat[/b] and that will define the outcome of the story!

We hope you embark on this journey to find our-self with us.

With love,

Stendhal Games

notes.content:
Join us for an exclusive [b]Steam Next Fest Event[/b], where a dedicated streamer will guide you through the full gameplay of Arcanima: Mist of Oblivion - Prologue for the first time!

Mark your calendars and prepare to immerse your-self in the mystical world of [b]Arcanima[/b]. Don’t miss this opportunity to be part of the journey before the official release!

[previewyoutube=GPRdKBkiJQI;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Arcanima: Mist of Oblivion[/b] combines Hack N Slash combat with JRPG elements, promising a deep and emotional story set in a world full of mysteries. Join us as we unravel the secrets of the Citadel of Indomita and explore the multicolored fog known as the ‘Mist of Oblivion’. See you there! 🌟🎮🔮

notes.title: We're extending the Beta Playtest! Open to everyone until 31 Jul
notes.content:
Hello anima users,

We're loving your reactions to the Beta, so we have decided to extend it until the end of the month and open it for everyone who requests it! If you didn't get access before, this is your perfect chance! Request access on our store page at any time.

Play the demo and once you're finished [b]please fill out the feedback survey you'll find within the game's menus[/b], it is very important for us to know your opinion and how we can make this the best game it can be!

With love, Stendhal Games

notes.title: JOIN our Beta Playtest and try the game! Starting 30th of June
notes.content:
[i]Hey, anima user![/i]

As Arcanima: Mist of Oblivion's first chapter comes close to being complete, [b]we're in need of some savvy players[/b] who can play the game and collaborate with us to make it better! [b]We need your help![/b]

[b]Request access to the Beta Playtest in our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2172500/Arcanima_Mist_of_Oblivion/]store page[/url][/b] and join the community in trying the game [b]starting on the 30th of June[/b], when we will unlock access [b]up until the 14th of July[/b]. During that time you'll be able to play the hour-long beta and give us your opinion and feedback on how to improve the game via a survey we'll provide you.

Really looking forward to all of you having a taste of the game! Everyone at Stendhal Games has been working very hard in making it the best it can be.

[i]See you on the 30th! #AwakeYourAnima[/i]
